content: Tabibapta̱ysein gamags yagan Yon
Livan bwanabwein nakabsilamaw towen; liva̱nen Yeisuw Kelis, mtowen Yowbad natun.
Liva̱nen Yon nises wanuwan Bukitab, Yowbad anilivan palopit towen Isaya nilel mamagina:
Tawkuwak wanawoud, ilana,
Yon igeiguy, makava nawoud waseg, ilana, “Kulavewas amisinap kalbaleb, babapta̱yseimiy va̱gan Yowbad biwidimiy bukukwamnats.” Igeiguy ma̱wan mo ibapta̱yses gamags.

Gamag babaw inekes Yon wanawoud, siven kweitan kweitan wawnuwan ven Yudiy sisiyas min-Yelusalem babaw, iliganes Yon nageiguy, mo ikamteles asisinap kalbaleb, ipiyaves, mo ibapta̱yses lay Yoldan wanuwan.
Yon nag ivag anakweim bwein. Tage wunuwunun kamel ivkek anakweim, isikam. Kaleivin man ivkek anawat. Kan ikamkwam kulipaw son kitoul.

Yon igeiguy, ilivan ma̱wan, ilana, “Yey nag tatawtoun, nag. Tatawtoun wankuyeim beim. Nag kadilokeig bakulul bakablev inasandol. Deisa babapta̱yseimiy wayevagam, towen gog mo bibapta̱yseimiy Yowbad Kululuwan Bwanabwein waseg.”
Yon ibaptays Yeisuw
Misumkwey towen, Yeisuw meinoy neim Nasalet wawnuwan ven Galiliy, iwek Yon, mo ibaptays Yeisuw, lay Yoldan waseg.
Ibaptays ikous, iga̱lag, mo ikin liba̱lab bo itavis, Kululuwan ibus im, iton wakunuwatan, ankakin ma̱wana bwabun italbelub im watinow.
Aygan teitan walba̱lab ilivan, ilana, “Ya̱koum natug bwanabwein yak. Singaya ibwein nanoug waseg ya̱koum.”
Seitan iyakwen Yeisuw
Ikous, kululuwan Yowbad mo ikayeb Yeisuw in wanawoud, isiw nawoud makaw waseg, sinawavas yam Seitan iyyakwen. Nawoud towen bulawud man nisesus, tage min-liba̱lab inekes Yeisuw imtakavates.
Yeisuw isilamaw geiguy ven Galiliy waseg

Wankuyeim mo iyousis Yon inawes wa̱deil, Yeisuw mo iyum im waGaliliy, Yowbad liva̱nen bwanabwein waseg igeiguy mamagin, ilana. “Yowbad nakaleiwag bo bisap tut towen waseg. Kadiloka kulavewas amisinap kalbaleb, kusimounids livan bwanabwein waseg.”
Idawes taplapouls asteivas
Yeisuw inoun in ivvayal wadadan yevagam avakaein, yagan Galiliy, ikin Saymon son bwadan Andiluw iplapouls, peinan siwotet poul-wan.
Yeisuw idibakes, ilana, “Kumeis kwabkunigs yey, mo basekeimiy miwotet kweitan, va̱gan bukukwanes gamags.”
Iliganas tasiyas; mo ilavewas siwot, ibukunis gog Yeisuw.
Inounas nag kadiveiyov, ikines Sebediy nitun, Yemes son bwadan sisiyas tasiyas nawnataws wanuwan siwag iymiyeims wot.
Yeisuw ikines, mo idawes tasiyas asteiy, ilisawes gog times Sebediy wa̱wag siney natouwats, mo ibukunis Yeisuw.
Takayyeiluw teitan
Inounas ineis Kapaneyum. Sabat waseg isiw in wabuntuman tapwa̱loul yagan sinagog, ikatimlakay.
Iliganes nakatimlakay, isom ninous, peinan ma̱wana takaleiwag mounid, nag ma̱wan tasiyas takatimlakeins kaleiwag.
Sinagog wanuwan, takayyeiluw teitan nises, ikin Yeisuw, iwak; tasiyas yeiluw ilansa, “Gum-Nasalet ya̱koum Yeisuw, awoum kuyagagem. Kulisawem kunoun. Akakina yak Yowbad natun ya̱koum.”
Tage Yeisuw idibek, ilana, “Kukwa̱pay, kukilev gamag towen.”
Yeiluw iligen, mo iweiy gamag towen kabalamat, aygan avakaein iwak, ikilev, mo inoun.
Asibabaw ikines, isom ninous, illivans sisiyas wasigeis, ilansa, “Aw-kaleiwag towen? Adok kweivaw sinap, tawtoun. Idibek yeiluw mo ikanow aygan.”
Butun towen nuwanaw in vena babaw Galiliy waseg.
Takatouns ivag mo ibweins
Ilisawes sinagog towen siney Yemes, Yon; sisiyas Saymon, Andiluw, mo isiws wasibunatum tasiyas; togo yawan Saymon ikatoun nimmasis, won muyamuy; idibakes Yeisuw ma̱wan.
Yeisuw iligen, inek mana̱wen vin, iyous naman, itamnow; bo ibwein, ivag kaeis ikams.
Ka̱las iseilil kwayav waseg, mo imeyes takatouns babaw, sisiyas tasiyas baloum neiweiys.
Ven to gimgilis katuyouns babaw nimeis, itomos wawkwedan bunatum.
Tage Yeisuw mo ivag ibweins askatoun kweitan kweitan, o baloum ikayabes isawls. Tasiyas baloum iwtusis Yeisuw, togo nag itam va̱gan bikamteles.
Ininoun igeiguy
Iwotet ikous, imasis, ikous, mo ikit kakita beiyam, tage igaw dadub, isap, inoun in wanawoud, ikulul, initoug waseg Yowbad.
Saymon siney nagamag ikikunis, iba̱nes Yeisuw, ilansa, “Gamag babaw inineveims ya̱koum.”
Iw to Yeisuw, ilana, “Kumeis, tata̱vins vena babaw, bageiguy. Bo nam wotet towen silma̱nin.”
Mapuna inounas, igeiguy sinagog katanok katanok waseg, ven Galiliy wawnuwan; o siyas baloum ikkayabes isisawls.
Toulepel ivag ibwein
Toulepel teitan inek Yeisuw, ikulul wamatan, igilagel, ilana, “Tabta sivinam bukuva̱geig ba̱bwein?”
Yeisuw igeg nanon, iyasel naman, ikabkwen won, ilana, “Sivinag bukubwein.”
Ilivan ikous mo ilatimatet won, kaleivin bo ibwein.

Yeisuw ikayeb gamag towen, anilivan tawtoun waseg ilivan, ilana, “Awoum kudibek teitan gamag liva̱neig; awoum. Kukwa̱pay-wan, kunoun kun Yowbad wanbunatum bunavakaein, tanuwagan lun bikineim, muvavag kusek, ma̱wan Moses nakaleiwag kweiboug, vagan gamag bikakins, bilansa, ‘O, bo ibwein.’”

Toge nag iligen, isap, illivan liva̱nen Yeisuw nawotet towen, iliganes gamag babaw. Mapuna Yeisuw nag kadilok binoun wamnat o binoun bein waven, tage isiwana wanawoud, vena babaw gimgilis mo ininekes.
